- Is the goal an outcome?

- We are NOT a free-to-play studio.

- No dark patterns.

## Duplicate prevention

## Routine slots

- ceo: weekly review

No monthly capital cap was stated, so the generated `.paperclip.yaml` carries **no
per-agent budgets**. Set a per-agent `budgetMonthlyCents` for every agent in
Paperclip before enabling heartbeats — an uncapped agent can run up real spend.
